about: Collector wire v2 (docs/platform/STEP2_SHARED_RULES.md 4.1). One set of examples for both sides: the engine posts them (tests/unit/test_collector_wire_v2.py), next-admin builds them from the seeds below (lib/collect/__tests__/collect-wire-v2.test.ts). Change both sides and this file in one commit.
wire_versions: The engine lists the versions it accepts in its grant-exchange answer (wire_versions); next-admin sends v2 (this file's shapes, aside, channels, keepAside) only when "2" is listed, else the v1 shape. An engine that answers without the key accepts v1 only.
seed_shapes: Exactly two: a claim (entity://claim/<id>, meta exactly kind, entityName, angles, languages, providers) or an https:// URL with no meta or meta exactly {"pasted": bool}. A claim seed searches in exactly one language, the one its entityName is written in (engine collection_run.query_language: zh when it holds a Chinese character, else en): never a Chinese question with English words appended; a second language is a second seed whose entityName is a translation. Every seed uri once. Never Perplexity: providers and every channel and searchProvider are serper or brave.
relevance_rules: Every key is optional except pasted. A pasted page carries no search* key. The whole object is at most max_relevance_bytes as Python json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False) measures it.
channel_rules: One row per (provider, lang) for the whole run: collect merges a channel's reports into one (an engine that answered once is ok; next-admin orchestrator.ts mergeChannel). A completion that repeats a pair is refused by the engine (400, the run ends failed): two rows for one channel are ambiguous, and the engine would read the worse one.

reading.about: What the engine may conclude from what collect sends (cognitive-engineering-os ai_lego/platform/block_hooks/gather.py: a conclusion that rests on something being absent needs input read whole). text: a page's body only -- its header, footer, menus and asides are dropped (next-admin collectors/http-html.ts extractText), so 誰辦的 not said in it is 無法檢查, never 查不到; the examples below are run through extractText on next-admin's side. title: cut at 300 characters. outlinks: every other host the page links to only when it holds fewer than relevance.outlinks.items hosts, every host is ASCII, the relevance has room for one more host of relevance.outlinks.max characters, and an empty list comes with imageUrl (an older collect trimmed lists to [] and then dropped the image); otherwise collect may have cut it and the page is never in an 只互相引用 group. Collect sends the list whole or omits the key: over max_relevance_bytes the links go first and whole, and a host over relevance.outlinks.max drops the list (no list = not whole).

公會調整合約範本

公會公告：自二〇一九年起，合約範本第七條改為按月結算。公會在週一寄給會員的信裡說，這是範本寫成以來第一次修改，舊合約到期前仍照原本的方式按件結算。

多位會員表示，按月結算可以減少對帳的時間，但也有人擔心小型工作室的現金週轉會變得比較緊。公會說，下個月會舉辦兩場說明會，回答會員對新條文的疑問，並收集修改意見。
